title: Simulation phases
statement: For a state type $S$ and a natural number $r$, a simulation phase is one of three forms: running simulation $j$ in state $q$, with optional output $o$ and counter $c$; rewinding after simulation $j$ has halted, with counter $c$; or seeking the left end of the input before simulation $j$, with counter $c$. In each form, $j$ ranges from $0$ to $r$ inclusive, and $c$ ranges from $0$ to $r+1$ inclusive.
